metrics.name: Logic & Reasoning
metrics.description: Syllogistic validity, absence of formal and informal fallacies, clear causal links between premise and conclusion.

benchmarkLevels.exceptional: Deductively sound, explicitly articulated warrants, zero fallacies detected.
benchmarkLevels.proficient: Valid reasoning with minor unstated assumptions; well-structured premises.
benchmarkLevels.developing: Contains non-sequiturs or informal fallacies; logical links are fragile.
benchmarkLevels.novice: Assertion-based claims lacking deductive structure; multiple egregious fallacies.

metrics.name: Real-World Evidence
metrics.description: Quality, timeliness, and relevance of cited facts, statistical data, legislative precedents, and empirical studies.

benchmarkLevels.exceptional: Specific empirical citations with verifiable figures, dates, and named institutional sources.
benchmarkLevels.proficient: Cites general real-world examples and accurate facts with solid relevance.
benchmarkLevels.developing: Relying heavily on personal anecdotes or unsourced assertions.
benchmarkLevels.novice: Devoid of empirical grounding; pure speculation or demonstrably false claims.

metrics.name: Topic Relevance
metrics.description: Direct adherence to the core motion, avoiding deflection, topic drift, or peripheral red herrings.

benchmarkLevels.exceptional: Lasered directly on the crux of the motion; addresses fundamental policy trade-offs.
benchmarkLevels.proficient: Keeps focus on primary issues with negligible drift into tangents.
benchmarkLevels.developing: Focuses on peripheral issues, losing sight of the core motion.
benchmarkLevels.novice: Off-topic; completely evades the central question under debate.

metrics.name: Speech Clarity
metrics.description: Conciseness, rhetorical structure, effective signposting, and accessibility of vocabulary.

benchmarkLevels.exceptional: Crystal-clear structure, punchy signposting, zero verbal clutter, compelling cadence.
benchmarkLevels.proficient: Easily understood, well-organized points with good transitional flow.
benchmarkLevels.developing: Rambling or overly convoluted sentence structures; difficult to follow.

metrics.name: Rebuttal & Comeback
metrics.description: Direct engagement with and deconstruction of the opponent's prior arguments and counter-claims.

benchmarkLevels.exceptional: Systematically dismantles the opponent's premises, turns their evidence into concessions.
benchmarkLevels.proficient: Directly clashes with main opposing points and offers valid counter-evidence.
benchmarkLevels.developing: Only partially responds to opponent; leaves major challenges unanswered.
benchmarkLevels.novice: Ignores the opponent completely; repeats opening assertion as if unaddressed.
